title: Chromatin Immunoprecipitation Protocol
author: Gabriel Sanchez
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.knkcvcw

steps.title: Wash and equilibrate beads
steps.instruction: For each ChIP, place 160 µl protein A/G agarose beads (≈40 µl dry volume) in a tube, centrifuge 1 min at 6000 rpm, discard supernatant, add an equal dry‑bead volume of RIPA buffer and mix, centrifuge 1 min at 2600 rpm then 6 s at 10 000 rpm, discard supernatant, and wash four times with 1 ml RIPA buffer using the same centrifugation sequence.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge beads 1 min at 6000 rpm and remove supernatant
Add equal dry‑bead volume of RIPA buffer and mix
Centrifuge 1 min at 2600 rpm then 6 s at 10 000 rpm, discard supernatant
Wash 4× with 1 ml RIPA buffer, each wash: centrifuge 1 min at 2600 rpm then 6 s at 10 000 rpm, discard supernatant

steps.title: Block beads with nucleic acids
steps.instruction: Add to the washed beads an equal dry‑bead volume of RIPA buffer containing yeast tRNA to a final concentration of 200 µg ml⁻¹ and salmon sperm DNA to 40 µg ml⁻¹, incubate 1 h at room temperature on a rotating stand, centrifuge 1 min at 2600 rpm then 6 s at 10 000 rpm, discard supernatant, and finally add one dry‑bead volume of RIPA buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add RIPA buffer with tRNA (200 µg/ml) and salmon sperm DNA (40 µg/ml) to beads
Incubate 1 h at room temperature on a rotating stand
Centrifuge 1 min at 2600 rpm then 6 s at 10 000 rpm, discard supernatant
Add one dry‑bead volume of RIPA buffer

steps.title: Couple antibody to beads
steps.instruction: Using a P200 tip with the tip end cut off, transfer 40 µl dry beads from the slurry, mix with 160 µl RIPA buffer (keep the remaining bead slurry for later pre‑clear), add 3 µg of the specific antibody (or IgG), and incubate on a rotating stand at +4 °C for 4 h.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 40 µl dry beads with a cut‑off tip and resuspend in 160 µl RIPA buffer
Add 3 µg antibody or IgG
Incubate 4 h at 4 °C on a rotating stand

steps.title: Cross‑link cells with formaldehyde
steps.instruction: Add formaldehyde directly to the culture medium to a final concentration of 1 % (v/v) and incubate 10 min at room temperature; quench with glycine pH 7.5 to a final concentration of 250 mM for 5 min at room temperature; wash cells twice with 10 ml PBS, scrape cells in 1 ml PBS, split into two tubes, centrifuge 5 min at 3000 rpm, and discard supernatant (pellets may be flash‑frozen in liquid N₂).

substeps.instruction: Add 1 % formaldehyde, incubate 10 min at RT
Add glycine to 250 mM, incubate 5 min at RT
Wash twice with 10 ml PBS
Scrape cells into 1 ml PBS, split, centrifuge 5 min at 3000 rpm, remove supernatant

steps.title: Lyse cells and shear chromatin
steps.instruction: Resuspend each cell pellet in 600 µl ice‑cold RIPA lysis buffer, shear DNA in a Bioruptor nano (Diagenode) for 8 cycles at high setting (30 s on/30 s off), add 450 µl RIPA buffer (IP solution) to each tube, centrifuge 10 min at 15 000 rpm at +4 °C, and collect the supernatant (chromatin extract) without freezing.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellets in 600 µl ice‑cold RIPA lysis buffer
Sonicate 8 × 30 s on/30 s off, high setting
Add 450 µl RIPA buffer
Centrifuge 10 min at 15 000 rpm, 4 °C
Collect supernatant

steps.title: Pre‑clear chromatin with bead slurry
steps.instruction: Add the saved bead slurry from step 3 together with 3 µg normal goat IgG to the chromatin extract, incubate 1 h at 4 °C, centrifuge 1 min at 10 000 rpm, collect the supernatant, remove 100 µl for input, and add the remaining pre‑cleared chromatin to the antibody‑bound beads prepared in step 3; rotate overnight at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Mix chromatin with bead slurry and 3 µg goat IgG
Incubate 1 h at 4 °C
Centrifuge 1 min at 10 000 rpm, collect supernatant
Aliquot 100 µl for input
Add remainder to antibody‑bead mixture
Rotate overnight at 4 °C

steps.title: Wash immunoprecipitated beads
steps.instruction: Wash the beads four times with 1 ml RIPA wash buffer (spin 30 s at 2500 rpm then a few seconds at 10 000 rpm to compact beads, discard supernatant), wash once with TE buffer, and finally resuspend beads in 100 µl RIPA resuspension buffer.

substeps.instruction: Wash 4× with 1 ml RIPA wash buffer (2500 rpm 30 s, then 10 000 rpm few s), discard supernatant
Wash once with TE buffer
Resuspend beads in 100 µl RIPA resuspension buffer

steps.title: Reverse cross‑link and purify DNA
steps.instruction: Incubate beads and input samples at 65 °C overnight with agitation in a thermomixer, spin 1 min at 5000 rpm, transfer supernatant (discard beads), add 1 µg Proteinase K and incubate 1 h at 45 °C, purify DNA using the QIAquick PCR purification kit, and elute DNA in 50 µl water.

substeps.instruction: Incubate 65 °C overnight with agitation
Spin 1 min at 5000 rpm, collect supernatant
Add 1 µg Proteinase K, incubate 45 °C 1 h
Purify DNA with QIAquick kit
Elute DNA in 50 µl water
